test_title: PYST 32: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per Union Budget, 2025-26, what is the total allocation to the Ministry of Defence to strengthen India’s military capabilities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹6,81,210.27 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Union Budget 2025-26** was presented by the **Union Minister of Finance**, **Nirmala Sitharaman**, in **Parliament** on **February 1, 2025**.
 
• The **Ministry of Defence (MoD)** has been allocated a total of **₹6,81,210.27 crore** for the financial year **2025-26**, which is the highest among all ministries.
 
• This allocation represents approximately **13%** of the total **Union Budget** expenditure, highlighting the government's focus on national security and military modernization.
 
• Of the total amount, a significant portion of **₹1,87,358 crore** is dedicated to **Capital Outlay**, which is intended for the procurement of new weapon systems, aircraft, warships, and other military hardware.
 
• The budget focus remains on **Aatmanirbharta in Defence**, aiming to boost **domestic manufacturing** and reduce the **import** of critical defence equipment through initiatives like the **Defence Acquisition Procedure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Defence Pensions:** A substantial sum of **₹1,47,440.40 crore** has been set aside for **Defence Pensions** in the **2025-26** budget to support **veterans** and their families.
 
• **Revenue Expenditure:** The **Revenue** head, which includes **salaries**, **maintenance**, and operational costs of the **Army**, **Navy**, and **Air Force**, accounts for a major share of the non-capital spending.
 
• **Border Infrastructure:** To strengthen security along the **Line of Actual Control (LAC)** and **Line of Control (LoC)**, the **Border Roads Organization (BRO)** has received enhanced funding for constructing **strategic tunnels**, **bridges**, and **roads**.
 
• **Innovation and R&D:** The government continues to support the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** and schemes like **iDEX (Innovations for Defence Excellence)** to foster **startups** and **MSMEs** in the defence technology sector.
 
• **Comparison:** The allocation of **₹6,81,210.27 crore** in **2025-26** is an increase from the **₹6,21,540.85 crore** allocated in the **2024-25** budget, reflecting a steady growth in **defence spending** to tackle evolving regional threats.
